security_audit.summary: Most static blocker, path traversal, certificate-key, obfuscation, and backtick findings are false positives from Markdown, CSS, or design-token text. Confirmed risks remain in external CDN loading, runtime dependency bootstrapping, ffmpeg subprocess execution, dynamic package imports, environment propagation, and unsanitized generated HTML in the design picker.

remediation.issue: Remote CDN scripts and fonts are loaded by templates and showcases.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor required scripts and fonts locally, or pin remote assets with integrity checks and document the network access clearly.

remediation.issue: The package loader can run npm install and re-execute Node with inherited environment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer documented manual installation, keep package specs pinned, avoid forwarding the full environment, and require explicit user confirmation for any bootstrap.

remediation.issue: Generated design picker preview HTML is assigned to innerHTML.
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize preview_html with an allowlist, escape user-facing text fields, or render previews in a sandboxed context with a restrictive content policy.

remediation.issue: The audio extraction script invokes ffmpeg and writes to a user-selected output path.
remediation.suggestion: Validate input and output paths, prevent accidental overwrites by default, and document that untrusted media is processed by ffmpeg.

use_cases.description: Start from a bundled FRAME.md preset, then adapt the tone and visual details to a specific campaign.

use_cases.title: Review generated frame quality
use_cases.description: Use contrast and design adherence guidance to catch weak typography, low contrast, and web-like layouts before delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a starting style
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for selecting a clear direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-creative to choose a visual direction for a HyperFrames video about [product]. Recommend a palette, type pairing, and frame density.

prompt_templates.title: Create a frame spec
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for making a reusable design spec.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-creative to draft a frame.md direction for [brand]. Include color intent, typography, layout rules, texture, and composition constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Plan scene beats
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for multi-scene creative planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-creative to plan a [duration] HyperFrames video. Define the beat rhythm, visual hierarchy, narration tone, and per-scene creative role.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-creative to review this HyperFrames composition for brand adherence, video-scale typography, contrast, density, and generic web-page patterns.

output_examples.input: A launch video for a developer analytics tool.
output_examples.output: A restrained technical direction with dark canvas, precise mono metadata, sharp data panels, and a clear beat plan for credibility.

output_examples.input: A review of an existing frame design.
output: Hero type should scale up for video.

best_practices: Read the active design spec before choosing colors, fonts, or layout treatments.
Use video-scale typography and enough foreground detail for every scene.
Keep references task-specific so simple edits do not load every guide.
anti_patterns: Using web-page spacing and small UI text in a video frame.
Adding scenes, narration, captions, or transitions when the user did not ask for them.
Rendering generated design picker HTML from untrusted sources without review.

faq.question: Is this an animation skill?
faq.answer: No. It covers creative direction and frame design. Detailed motion patterns belong in hyperframes-animation.

faq.question: Can it create a frame.md file?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives guidance for creating or adapting frame.md and design.md specifications for HyperFrames projects.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made styles?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes frame presets such as editorial, professional, poster, grid, and playful directions.

faq.question: Does it need external tools?
faq.answer: Some optional scripts use Node.js, Python, ffmpeg, browser capture tooling, and web fonts.

faq.question: Can it help with narration?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include narration pacing, tone, openings, and number pronunciation guidance.

faq.question: Is the design picker safe for all inputs?
faq.answer: No. It renders generated preview HTML, so users should review options and avoid untrusted markup.
